name: Timetable picker
description: A station timetable with one row per hour and the minutes set out along it, for choosing a departure and seeing when it arrives.

props.name: departures
props.type: { time: string; kind: "local" | "rapid" | "express"; arrives: string; to?: string; platform?: string }[]
props.description: Every departure in the day, as 24-hour "HH:MM" times. Rapid trains carry a dot and express trains a diamond, and express minutes are set in bold.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen departure time (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a departure is chosen, with its full record.

props.name: now
props.description: The time now, as "HH:MM". Earlier departures are dimmed, its hour is tinted, and the next departure is ringed and underlined.

props.name: allowPast
props.description: Lets trains that left before now be chosen. By default they are dimmed, announced as departed and cannot be picked.

props.name: from
props.description: Departure station, shown under the time in the summary.

props.name: to
props.description: Arrival station, shown under the arrival time.

props.name: label
props.description: Heading, which also names the timetable grid.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the heading, such as the day and the line.

props.name: kindLabels
props.description: Names for the train types in the key, the summary and for assistive technology.
